findings.summary: In the DATA_START path, when the body arrives in chunks with no boundary yet, last_newline() can point at the leading line break, so data_end/del_index don't strip it and the next DATA call emits the body with a stray leading \r\n.

judge.reason: Identifies that last_newline() in DATA_START cuts at the leading CRLF (index 0..2) with no boundary, the same cause as b1, though it describes the symptom as a stray leading newline rather than stalling.
